title: To be clad in "Sunlight" filtered by the trees.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ahh～ sunlight being filtered by the 
leaves… It warms my body right up. This is 
just the best…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's as though I'm walking through the 
fields of South America. Hahaha, basking 
in the sun, even my clothes are absorbing 
the sunlight…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm… huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: This light… it's not disappearing?

I came across Stay Gold, who was 
restlessly looking over her body.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey, you… can you see it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
So you can't see it… Maybe only I can see 
it? Could it actually not be sunlight 
through the leaves?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What on Earth is this? I'm counting… 1… 2… 
3… 4…

When I asked what was bothering her —— 
Apparently there were a lot of tiny lights 
twirling around her body.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's not a Genji-botaru firefly or a 
Hotaria parvula firefly. So if it isn't a 
light from a firefly…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Maybe moth scales or some type of 
ectoplasm…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Whatever could this light be? The colors 
are diverse, the illumination sways from 
sparkling to flickering, it's all over the 
place…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I don't get it. But it sure is 
interesting! I want to uncover the truth 
behind this…
choice_data_list: <size=38>How about consulting an expert on ghosts?</size>

I think you can swat it down with your 
tail.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
An expert on ghosts? I see. When it comes 
to that… there's only one place.

text_block_list.name: Buddhist Monk
text_block_list.text: T-This light is…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, so you can see it. As expected from 
the head monk. Well, do you know what it 
is?

text_block_list.name: Buddhist Monk
text_block_list.text: I do not. But, this is…

text_block_list.name: Buddhist Monk
text_block_list.text:
It might be something akin to a 
"fragmented thought". I feel a faint 
spiritual energy behind them…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A spiritual energy, huh. I see, it could 
very well be…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Nothing to that extent, but if this 
originates from someone's spirit…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
There's probably someone who wants this 
back. Someone, somewhere on this plant.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Swat it with my… tail? Alright, just gotta 
do it like I'm swatting bugs when I'm 
camping!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hah! Take this!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it's still not vanishing… I'm 
certain I hit them too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well then, this has to be something 
spiritual then.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And if it's something spiritual, that 
means there's probably someone out there 
that needs this back. Well, I'll take my 
time looking into it.
